'''Tear of the Soul''' is an island south-east of the [[Isle of Souls]]. Level 61 [[Sailing]] is required to [[moor]] at the island (not boostable), along with a [[boat]] furnished with an [[inoculation station]] (can be a friend's boat, though 61 Sailing will still be required); however, the island can be accessed without protection from [[fetid waters]] by carefully navigating a boat on the edge of the hazardous water near the [[Mooring point (scenery)|mooring point]].

A [[Small key (Tear of the Soul)|small key]] can be dug up on the island, two tiles west of the rowboat/[[rowboat space]]. This key can be used to unlock a [[Lockbox (Buccaneers' Haven)|lockbox]] on [[Buccaneers' Haven]] containing an [[eternal brazier schematic]].

[[Sleve McDichael]] offers services to rename boats here at the cost of 1 [[cider]], and [[Biles]] can exchange banknotes for 5 coins per banknote. [[Yew tree]]s, [[Sand Crab|sand crabs]], and an [[iron axe]] spawn can also be found on the island. The island also has two [[burnt tree]]s, although they are unreachable.

It contains one hard tier treasure trail step.

==Transportation==
* Disembark at the mooring point by sailing to the island (61 Sailing). 
* Teleport to the [[Isle of Souls]] via the [[Soul Wars Portal]] or [[Minigame Teleport]], then run south-east and take the rowboat (must be constructed first, see below).

==Building the amenities==
A rowboat can be built with a saw, hammer, and the following [[Construction]] level and materials. Be aware that you can only build the rowboat facility on the Tear of the Soul island and not on the Isle of Souls. However, the boat will only take players a very short distance west to the [[Isle of Souls]], and both locations have nearby [[Mooring point|mooring points]]. It is primarily useful for those wishing to access the island quickly when completing [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard Treasure Trails]].

In total, players will need the following items to build all of the [[Island amenity|amenities]]:

{{Checklist|
*1 [[hammer]]  '''(required for all facilities)'''
*1 [[saw]]  '''(required for all facilities)'''
*10 [[swamp paste]]
*8 [[camphor plank]]s

==Trivia==
* After washing up on the island, Biles wished to name it "Drumstick Isle", but could not do so as that name was already taken by [[Drumstick Isle|another island]]. He had to settle for establishing the Drumstick Kingdom on the Tear of the Soul instead, as he could not change the name of the island itself.{{CiteNPC|npc=Biles|quote=Yes, I wanted to call this place Drumstick Isle because I thought it looked like a chicken drumstick, but apparently that name was taken. I settled for Drumstick Kingdom instead. [Player: So that's the name of this island?] No, just the kingdom. This island already had a name as well, so I can't change it.}}
